skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of construction organization and planning, and its application in real estate development.
Understand the role of construction planning in the quality of construction projects, real estate value, and user safety.
Understand the latest construction technologies and methods, including earthworks, foundation, concrete, and assembly construction.
Understand the layout and organization of construction sites, including temporary facilities, material storage, and equipment.
Understand the methods and importance of construction progress scheduling.
Develop skills in communication, teamwork, decision-making, and project management.
Understand the social responsibility of construction organizations, and develop a professional and cooperative attitude.
Develop the ability to work independently and adapt to different environments.
Develop the ability to analyze social context and work environment, and ensure personal responsibility and professional ethics.
